items.source: Declare a Table to SELECT … FROM. Multiple calls to this or other from methods keep adding items to the select list and do not replace previously contained items.
items.translation: 声明一个Table用于SELECT … FROM。多次调用此方法或其他from方法会向选择列表中添加项目，而不会替换之前包含的项目。

items.source: Declare one or more Tables to SELECT … FROM. Multiple calls to this or other from methods keep adding items to the select list and do not replace previously contained items.
items.translation: 声明一个或多个Table到SELECT … FROM中。多次调用此方法或其他from方法会不断向选择列表中添加项，而不会替换之前包含的项。

items.source: Declare a Table to SELECT … FROM.

items.source: Declare one or more Tables to SELECT … FROM.
items.translation: 声明一个或多个Table以用于SELECT … FROM。

items.source: tables - the tables to SELECT … FROM must not be null.
items.translation: <tables> - 必须为 SELECT ... FROM 指定表，不能为空。
